title: Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A classic Southeast Asian dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection and served with spicy peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: jaded (or other type of wood skewers)

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, ginger, garlic, and satay spice mix. Blend until smooth.
Thread chicken breast onto the jaded skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in a shallow dish and pour the marinade over them. Make sure they are fully coated.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Brush with peanut sauce during the last minute of grilling.
Serve with additional peanut sauce and cucumber slices on the side.
